description: No SCENE_JSON, VIEWS_MANIFEST_JSON, or images were present in the conversation payload. Unable to analyze CoffeeMachine2 scene contents, identify interaction/visualization elements, or ground a state machine in actual Unity object structure.

diagnostics.message: Missing SCENE_JSON. Provide the exported Unity scene JSON so object names/paths, roles, interactionParams, tags, transforms, colliders, and materials can be used directly.
Missing VIEWS_MANIFEST_JSON (optional). If available, it helps map camera views/screens/overlays to visualization elements.
No images attached. If provided, they can be used to confirm/adjust roles and relationships but not measurements.

Once SCENE_JSON is provided, I will: (1) list all interactables (colliders, tagged interactables, buttons/levers/doors), (2) list visualization outputs (screens, indicator lights, UI canvases, particle/steam, liquid), (3) add relations (e.g., button->brew action, water level->indicator), and (4) propose a grounded coffee-machine state machine mapping states to specific Unity object activations/animations/material changes.
